title: High-score Worker capability
description: What the Shatterbelt Worker does besides serving files.

entities.name: Replay-checked high-score table
entities.description: Keeps the public table of pilots, from solo and online games alike.
entities.responsibility: Issues each game's seed, replays every submitted game with the game's own engine, and lists only the scores those replays produce, one row per named player.
access: Anyone may read the table, as JSON or as the web page.
Only a player signed in with the games:play role may get a seed or submit a game.
Each seed is accepted once, within 24 hours of being issued.

entities.name: Signed-in game page
entities.description: Serves the game only to players who are signed in.
entities.responsibility: Checks icelander.net's sign-in before serving the game's page.
access: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role; anyone signed out is sent to sign in and back.

relatedViews.relationship: The operations through which they are reached.
